svg.aria-label: Each time scale's offset from TAI from 1950 to 2030, with the periodic terms of TDB and TCB magnified by 100. TT is a constant 32.184 seconds. TDB and TCG stay close to TT. TCB drifts from about 19 to about 58 seconds. UTC steps down from minus 10 seconds at 1972 to minus 37 seconds, and ends at 2026.
svg.text: Periodic terms of TDB and TCB × 100
